world_offer_label: the Syriac Christian world of Edessa and Nisibis
_comment: Primary-text translations and secondary scholarship drawn from this world's own vetted Source Registry / Doc_02, curated for a participant who wants to go deeper after talking with this world's Representative.

resources.title: Ephrem the Syrian: Hymns
resources.author: Kathleen McVey (trans.)
resources.note: A translated selection of Ephrem's Hymns on the Nativity and Hymns on Virginity — direct access to the poetic, symbol-driven voice this world's own Representative speaks from.

resources.title: St. Ephrem the Syrian: Hymns on Paradise
resources.author: Sebastian Brock (trans.)
resources.note: A complete translation of Ephrem's fifteen Hymns on Paradise, composed at Nisibis — one of the richest single works for encountering his symbolic theology directly.

resources.title: The Luminous Eye: The Spiritual World Vision of Saint Ephrem the Syrian
resources.author: Sebastian Brock
resources.note: The most accessible introduction to how Ephrem's Syriac tradition thinks in symbol (raza) rather than philosophical category — a genuinely different theological idiom from the Greek and Latin worlds at this table.

resources.title: The Demonstrations of Aphrahat, the Persian Sage
resources.author: Adam Lehto (trans.)
resources.note: The standard complete modern translation of Aphrahat's twenty-three Demonstrations, this world's other great fourth-century voice, writing from the Persian side under Shapur II's persecution.

resources.title: Symbols of Church and Kingdom: A Study in Early Syriac Tradition
resources.author: Robert Murray
resources.note: The foundational study of the distinctive images and symbols (the Church as bride, Christ as physician, Paradise as regained garden) running through this whole tradition.
